entries.translation: Oiemu dabua dekenai, oiemu toana. Oiemu kudouna dekenai, bese ena kara.
entries.note: Papuan standard; transcreated as style in clothing, people’s way in heart; native review required.

entries.translation: Stil koji nosiš. Kultura koju nosiš sa sobom.
entries.note: Informal singular; sa sobom preserves culture carried with oneself without implying dissemination.

entries.translation: A stílus, amit viselsz. A kultúra, amit hordozol.
entries.note: Informal singular; hordozol naturally conveys bearing and embodying.

entries.translation: Ụdị ejiji ị na-eyi. Omenala ị na-ebu.
entries.note: Ụdị ejiji specifies personal dress style; native copy review advised.

entries.translation: Stíllinn sem þú klæðist. Menningin sem þú berð með þér.
entries.note: Natural informal singular; klæðast governs clothing sense.

entries.translation: La stilo quan tu portas. La kulturo quan tu portas.
entries.note: Portar supports wear and bear; deliberate repetition preserves balance.

entries.translation: ꆏꃢꈜꎔꈚ。ꆏꆈꌠꋊꃤꌌ。
entries.transliteration: Ne vit gga nrat ggat. Ne Nuosu cyt vi sip.
entries.note: Standard Liangshan Yi; transcreated as beautiful dress and Nuosu lineage; native review required.

entries.translation: ᐋᖅᑭᒃᓯᒪᓂᖓ ᐊᑐᖅᑕᐃᑦ. ᐃᓕᖅᑯᓯᖅ ᓇᒃᓴᖅᑕᐃᑦ.
entries.note: Nunavut syllabics; morphology and culture term checked, native slogan review advised.

entries.translation: Li stil quel tu porta. Li cultura quel tu porta.
entries.note: Modern Interlingue; parallel use of portar preserves wordplay.

entries.translation: Le stilo que tu porta. Le cultura que tu porta.
entries.note: Natural parallel Romance syntax; portare covers wear and carry.

entries.translation: Gaya yang kaukenakan. Budaya yang kaubawa.
entries.note: Concise informal singular; exact balanced relative-clause syntax.

entries.translation: Irrusiq atiġiñ. Iḷitqusiq tigummiġiñ.
entries.note: Imperative transcreation: wear style, hold culture; North Alaskan spelling; native review required.

entries.translation: Lo stile che indossi. La cultura che porti con te.
entries.note: Native, concise, informal singular; con te keeps figurative carrying clear.

entries.translation: Gaya sing kokanggo. Kabudayan sing kokgawa.
entries.note: Standard Latin-script ngoko; intimate direct-address register.

entries.translation: 身にまとうスタイル。心に宿す文化。
entries.transliteration: Mi ni matou sutairu. Kokoro ni yadosu bunka.
entries.note: Native fashion phrasing: style on body, culture dwelling in heart.

entries.translation: Atisalersoriaatsimik atuisarputit. Piorsarsimassutsimik tigummiartarputit.
entries.note: Standard West Greenlandic; native compounds avoid Danish culture/style loans; review cadence with native copywriter.

entries.translation: ನೀವು ಧರಿಸುವ ಶೈಲಿ. ನೀವು ಹೊತ್ತೊಯ್ಯುವ ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿ.
entries.transliteration: Nīvu dharisuva śaili. Nīvu hottōyyuva saṃskr̥ti.
entries.note: Respectful second person; ಹೊತ್ತೊಯ್ಯುವ suggests carrying onward.

entries.translation: پۄشاکَس مَنٛز اَنٛداز۔ دِلَس مَنٛز تَہذیٖب۔
entries.transliteration: Pōshākas manz andāz. Dilas manz tahzīb.
entries.note: Perso-Arabic standard; gender-neutral transcreation: style in dress, culture in heart; native review required.

entries.translation: Fasal do sǝkǝna dǝ. Ada do gozana dǝ.
entries.note: Yerwa Central Kanuri in Latin orthography; ISO macrolanguage choice; native review required.

entries.translation: Киетін стилің. Бойыңда алып жүретін мәдениетің.
entries.transliteration: Kietin stiliñ. Boıyñda alyp jüretin mädenietiñ.
entries.note: Balanced noun phrases; бойыңда makes culture embodied within; native slogan review required.

entries.translation: រចនាប័ទ្មដែលអ្នកពាក់។ វប្បធម៌ដែលអ្នកយកតាមខ្លួន។
entries.transliteration: Rôchnâbât dael neak peăk. Vôppôthoăm dael neak yôk tam khluŏn.
entries.note: Formal native style term; second clause explicitly means carry with oneself.

entries.translation: Mũtindo ũrĩa wĩhumbaga. Mũtugo ũrĩa ũkuaga.
entries.note: Central Gĩkũyũ; mũtindo is established regional style term; native review required.

entries.translation: Imiterere wambara. Umuco witwaza.
entries.note: Concise singular; witwaza means carry with oneself, including figuratively.

entries.translation: Сен кийген стиль. Боюңда алып жүргөн маданият.
entries.transliteration: Sen kiygen stil. Boyuñda alyp jürgön madaniyat.
entries.note: Informal singular; second clause means culture carried within oneself.

entries.translation: Стиль тэ новлан. Культура тэ нуан.
entries.transliteration: Stil te novlan. Kultura te nuan.
entries.note: Standard Komi-Zyrian; Russian-derived nouns are established usage; native cadence review advised.

entries.translation: Mutindu uvwata. Kinkulu unata.
entries.note: Conservative central Kikongo rather than separate Kituba; macrolanguage variation requires native-market review.

entries.translation: 입는 스타일. 지니는 문화.
entries.note: Compact slogan syntax; 지니다 conveys carrying, possessing, and embodying.

entries.translation: Oto djala nonghedi. Oto humbata omufyuululwakalo.
entries.note: Namibian Oshikwanyama orthography; transcreated as dress with style, carry heritage; native review required.

entries.translation: Şêwaza ku tu li xwe dikî. Çanda ku tu bi xwe re dibî.
entries.note: Kurmanji Latin chosen as widest-recognized written variety; Sorani needs separate localization.

entries.translation: ແບບທີ່ເຈົ້ານຸ່ງໃສ່. ວັດທະນະທຳທີ່ເຈົ້າພົກພາ.
entries.transliteration: Bǣp thī chao nung sai. Vatthanatham thī chao phok pha.
entries.note: Native style term avoids English loan; ພົກພາ means carry along.

entries.translation: Stilum geris. Culturam tecum fers.
entries.note: Modern Latin senses; geris versus fers preserves wear/carry distinction.
